title.narrative: The Global Fund Supported Project on HIV/AIDS in Viet Nam - Viet Nam (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Viet Nam, HIV, Viet Nam Union of Science and Technology Associations (LHH Vietnam)This program has the following goals: To strengthen the participation of social and community-based organizations to contribute to achieving the target of 95-95-95 and objectives of the National Strategy to End the AIDS Dease by 2030.. The objectives of this program are: Provide community HIV prevention services for key populations (MSM, TGW, FSW, PWID) in 17 provinces/cities. Strengthen community systems for eficient, resilient and stainable HIV/AIDS responses.. Improve access to health services for key populations.
